confess_not_carp.clause: the full stack backtrace from "confess" will not start inside of "Carp"

eval_failure.clause: "eval" returns "undef" in scalar context, or an empty list in list context, and $@ is set to the error message.

formatter.clause: For any type of reference, $Carp::RefArgFormatter is checked

full_trace.clause: that context is a summary of every call in the call-stack; "longmess()" returns the contents of the error message.

global_logic.clause: You can also alter the way the output and logic of "Carp" works, by changing some global variables in the "Carp" namespace.

internal_skip.clause: the stack backtrace will not start inside packages that are listed in %Carp::CarpInternal.
